newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions six-month bonds in operation.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said it had auctioned six-month maturity short-term federal bonds worth 675 million rupees in a special open market operation on Thursday.

It said bids worth 475 million rupees were accepted for the outright sale of the bonds at a maximum cutoff of 16.74 percent a year. Bids worth 200 million rupees were accepted for five-month repurchase contract of the bonds at a maximum cutoff of 16.70 percent.

In its weekly open market operation on Wednesday, the central bank had accepted bids worth 5.395 billion rupees for outright sale of the bonds at a maximum cutoff of 16.749 percent and 2.8 billion rupees for five-month repurchase contract of the bonds at a maximum cutoff of 16.70 percent.
